package.name: polyumi_fr3_controllers
package.description: FR3 motion control for PolyUMI: a streaming Cartesian impedance controller for the arm, driven by absolutely-timed pose chunks from the policy client, plus the Franka Hand tooling that talks to libfranka directly rather than through franka_gripper. Control law ported from serl_franka_controllers; reference generator ported from UMI's PoseTrajectoryInterpolator.
